title: Magnetic Closure Box Sample Approval Before a Bulk Order
seo_title: Magnetic Closure Box Sample Approval for Bulk Orders
meta_description: Review a magnetic closure box sample before bulk production. Check lid alignment, insert height, packed fit and finishing, then record what you approve.
excerpt: Check your magnetic box with the shell empty, with the insert installed and with the full product set packed. Use the results to approve the sample for bulk production.
